name: r6_physics_features_li_kappa
author: first_agent
entrant_decision: 2026-09-29: yes, continue with new features for li and kappa
question: Do input-only physics features (kinetic pressure / beta_p proxy, profile peaking and width, edge pedestal, current and conductivity history) carry information about the v25-recipe network ERROR in li and kappa that the current 367 inputs plus the finished map do not?
data: K-fold OOF archives (C/kfold/oof_fold0..4: 400 training shots never seen by their networks), every 2nd frame as in C/kfold/features_fold*.npz
targets: per frame residual = truth - OOF finished map, for li and kappa; truth = lcfs table labels li_scored and kappa (scorer reading of the basis map), map = features_fold map_features columns li and kappa

arms.A: 367 inputs + the 7 map-read scalars of the OOF map
arms.B: A + physics block P (defined in r6_features.py, computed from fec_adapter.shot_reader aligned inputs and the raw plasma-current / Thomson traces only; no efit column)

model: HistGradientBoostingRegressor(max_iter 400, learning_rate 0.05, max_leaf_nodes 31, l2 1.0, early_stopping False, random_state 0)
evaluation: leave-one-fold-out over the 5 K-fold folds (fit on 4 folds' frames, predict the 5th); metric per target: R2 of the residual explained, and SSE reduction relative to the uncorrected map; B vs A paired over shots, 20000-resample shot bootstrap (seed 930)
decision: P is worth building into the recipe only if B beats A by >= 0.02 in residual R2 on li or kappa with P(B better) >= 0.95; otherwise recorded as no new information
